title: Thailand airport guides: Suvarnabhumi, Don Mueang, Phuket and Chiang Mai | ThaiLiveNow
description: Thailand airport guides cover Suvarnabhumi, Don Mueang, Phuket and Chiang Mai. Choose your airport for floor maps, arrivals, departures, facilities and airline counters.
intro: Before arriving in Thailand or taking your flight home, choose the airport you will use. Read where to find facilities and how to get through the airport, then explore airline counters and connecting flights.
relatedTitle: Is your flight delayed or canceled, or is there a baggage problem?
relatedIntro: The flight assistance guide explains what to ask your airline and how to report baggage problems.
relatedLink: Flight delays, cancellations and baggage help

airports.name: Suvarnabhumi Airport
airports.text: Read separate guides to arrivals, departures and connections, floor maps, smoking areas, transport into Bangkok and airline counters.

airports.name: Don Mueang Airport
airports.text: Find check-in and international departure procedures, the recommended time to reach your gate, and the locations of restaurants, banks and ATMs.

airports.name: Phuket Airport
airports.text: Find the international arrivals hall and baggage claim, self-check-in kiosks, medical rooms and ATMs.

airports.name: Chiang Mai Airport
airports.text: Read the airport opening hours and departure procedures, then find Grab, airport shuttles and city buses after arrival.
